title: Cocycle coherence for strict quotient pre-tower
statement: For any coefficient datum d and pre-tower P, the semilinear transitions of P satisfy the AdicTower cocycle equation for every comparable triple of indices, including equal indices.

proof.text: On pure tensors, both the direct and successive reductions multiply the same residue scalars. Balancing extends the equality to sheaf tensor products, and derived change of rings preserves it. Equal indices reduce to the identity normalization.

mathlib_searches.query: cocycle of quotient scalar extension transitions in an adic tower

theorem strictTateTensorTower_pre_cocycle
    (T : Scheme.{u}) {A : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A]
    (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A) (P : StrictTateTensorTowerPre T d) :
    P.Cocycle
